name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: Maps show wildfire smoke forecast, air quality alerts in swath of U.S.
changes.summary: Heavy smoke from several large wildfires blazing in Canada and Minnesota is engulfing large swaths of the Midwest and the U.S. East Coast this week.

changes.title: Trump fumes over Canadian wildfire smoke and issues tariff threat
changes.summary: President Donald Trump on Friday pledged to hold Canada responsible for costs associated with unhealthy air quality in the U.S. due to spreading smoke from the Canadian wildfires.

changes.title: AIPAC Closes Donor Portal to Democrats Who Voted to End Aid to Israel
changes.summary: The pro-Israel lobbying group appeared to be punishing Democrats it had endorsed for re-election after they voted in favor of an amendment that would have cut off U.S. aid to Israel.

changes.title: Trump Threatens Canada With Tariffs for Wildfire Smoke Over U.S.
changes.summary: The president said on Friday in a social media post that Canada was failing to manage its wildfire response as smoke has blanketed U.S. cities including New York and Chicago.

changes.title: U.S. and Iran escalate strikes across Mideast
changes.summary: The United States and Iran exchanged strikes aimed at infrastructure and military targets on Saturday as their battle over the Strait of Hormuz intensified. (Image credit: Razieh Poudat/AP Photo).

changes.title: Far above the Earth, NASA's Apollo lunar lander put astronauts on the moon
changes.summary: America's most daring, extraordinary feat—landing astronauts on the moon—remains the pinnacle of achievement by anyone anywhere. Ever.

changes.title: Russia Bill Broadens Sanctions but Could Fuel Fears Over the Dollar
changes.summary: The Trump administration has recently sought to scale back sanctions as adversaries develop workarounds that some believe could erode the U.S. dollar’s supremacy.

changes.title: As Trump Scraps With Meloni, His Envoy to Italy Is at Sea
changes.summary: Tilman J. Fertitta, the U.S. ambassador to Rome, is summering on his superyacht as President Trump squabbles with Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni of Italy.
